tree: Know what happens on every call.
See call volume, answer rates, duration and outcomes in real time. Each call comes with a summary, sentiment and the result, so you know what to improve.

tree.aria-label: Noxtill call analytics: a list of calls with outcomes, a call transcript, and the call summary with duration, sentiment and daily totals

tree: Thanks for calling Noxtill Salon, this is Maya.

You’re booked. We’ll text you a reminder.
What does call analytics software measure?

Call analytics tracks how many calls you get, how many are answered, how long they last and what happened on each one. It shows which times are busiest and which team members convert calls into bookings or sales.
Owners can’t see how many calls are missed or how they end.
Every call has an outcome, a summary and a place in the trends.
Call analytics turns every call into useful data.
Get detailed analytics and reports on call volume, answer rates, missed calls, call duration, peak hours and team performance.
Get all the important call metrics in one place.
Turn your call data into actionable insights. Useful for any business or team.
Insights from every call you take.
Everything you need to know about Noxtill's call analytics.
